description: A composite eight-panel figure that mixes two modalities: EBSD boundary maps (a–d) and dark-field TEM images (e–h). (a–d) are EBSD maps of Fe(x)Mn11Al1C low-density steel with x = 20%, 25%, 30% and 35% Mn, each with a 200 μm scale bar; a shared legend defines thin black lines as θ>15° boundaries, red lines as twin boundaries, and green as the BCC (ferrite) phase. Green BCC phase is clearly present in (a) and weakly in (b), and absent from (c) and (d); red twin boundaries thread through grains in all four maps, and grains coarsen progressively from (a) to (d). (e–h) are dark-field TEM images of the κ-carbide in the same 20→35% Mn sequence, each with an inset SAED pattern taken along [001]γ and indexed (000), (010)γ, (100)γ, (020)γ, (200)γ, with yellow squares marking the κ reflections; the 100 nm scale bar in (e–f) switches to 20 nm in (g–h). Bright κ-carbide particles are coarsest in (e) and finest in (h). Together the panels argue that raising Mn removes ferrite, coarsens the austenite grains and refines the κ-carbides; no numeric values are printed on any panel.

observations.observation: Each EBSD map (a–d) carries a 200 μm scale bar.
A single legend at the bottom defines black lines as θ>15° boundaries, red lines as twin boundaries and green as the BCC phase.
Green BCC (ferrite) phase regions are visible in (a), are much less frequent in (b), and are not visible in (c) or (d).
Red twin boundaries are numerous within the grains of all four EBSD maps (a–d), and the grain size increases progressively from (a) to (d).
The dark-field TEM panels (e) and (f) use a 100 nm scale bar, whereas (g) and (h) use a 20 nm scale bar, consistent with finer κ-carbide in the higher-Mn samples.

The inset SAED patterns are indexed (000), (010)γ, (100)γ, (020)γ and (200)γ, with yellow squares marking the spots attributed to the κ phase; the Miller indices of the yellow-squared κ spots themselves are not printed.
Bright κ-carbide particles are largest in the dark-field image (e) (20%Mn) and become progressively smaller and less distinct through (f), (g) and (h).
The caption states the EBSD maps show grain and twin boundary (Σ3) arrangement together with the BCC phase fraction for 20%, 25%, 30% and 35% Mn.
The caption states each dark-field TEM image was taken along the [001]γ zone axis using one of the κ-carbide diffraction spots shown in the inset SAED patterns.

The citing text states the 20%Mn sample contains ferrite with a grain size of about 4.1 μm and volume fraction of 3.3%, an austenite grain size of about 9.9 μm and a twin boundary fraction of about 62%.
The citing text states the 25%Mn sample has a ferrite phase fraction of 0.65% with ferrite grain size about 4.5 μm and an austenite grain size of about 18.8 μm.
The citing text states the 30%Mn and 35%Mn samples are single austenite phase with average grain sizes of about 23.7 μm and 33 μm, and twin boundary fractions of about 60% in both.
The citing text states the average κ-carbide size is about 18 nm in the 20%Mn sample, decreasing to 5 nm, 3 nm and 2 nm for 25%, 30% and 35% Mn respectively.

subfigures.description: EBSD boundary/phase map of the 20%Mn sample, 200 μm scale bar; many equiaxed grains outlined by black θ>15° boundaries, abundant red twin boundaries, and green BCC (ferrite) phase present as scattered patches and along a band.
EBSD map of the 25%Mn sample, 200 μm scale bar; grains similar to (a) with dense red twin boundaries, but green BCC phase markedly reduced compared with (a).
EBSD map of the 30%Mn sample, 200 μm scale bar; coarser grains with red twin boundaries, no green BCC phase visible.
EBSD map of the 35%Mn sample, 200 μm scale bar; the coarsest grains of the four maps, red twin boundaries present, no green BCC phase visible.

Dark-field TEM image of the 20%Mn sample, 100 nm scale bar, showing coarse bright κ-carbide particles; inset SAED along [001]γ indexed (000), (010)γ, (100)γ, (020)γ, (200)γ with yellow squares on the κ reflections.
Dark-field TEM image of the 25%Mn sample, 100 nm scale bar; bright κ-carbide particles visibly finer than in (e); inset SAED with the same [001]γ indexing scheme.
Dark-field TEM image of the 30%Mn sample, 20 nm scale bar; very fine bright κ-carbide particles; inset SAED along [001]γ with yellow squares marking κ spots.
Dark-field TEM image of the 35%Mn sample, 20 nm scale bar; the finest and most sparsely resolved bright κ-carbide particles of the series; inset SAED along [001]γ.

SAED spot labels in the (g) and (h) insets are small and only partially readable at the supplied resolution
